result.summary: Several layout and content overflow issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edges, and one promo card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the full label and remaining categories are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the category row is fully scrollable with adequate end padding, or wrap/scale chips so labels are not clipped.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is cropped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent card widths and right-side padding, or make the row clearly horizontally scrollable so the last card is fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card (pizza with '-100%' badge) is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without an ellipsis or wrap, making the name incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis or two-line wrapping so truncated names remain readable.
